housing.summary: Winterthur is Zurich canton's second city with more affordable rents than Zurich city. Average 1-BR city-centre apartments run ~CHF 1,910/month per Numbeo (Jun 2026). Swiss law caps the rental deposit at 3 months' rent. Main portals: homegate.ch, comparis.ch, immoscout24.ch.

banking.summary: To open a bank account in Switzerland, residents need valid ID, proof of Swiss residence registration (Anmeldebestätigung), and permit (non-EU). Winterthur falls under Zurich canton; main banks are UBS, Zürcher Kantonalbank (ZKB), and Raiffeisen. PostFinance serves the whole country.
required_docs: Employer letter or salary slip (sometimes required)

schools.summary: Winterthur has public German-language schools as the main educational option. For international education, families typically commute to Zurich international schools. Some private bilingual schools exist in the greater Zurich/Winterthur area. Zurich International School (ZIS) has a campus relatively nearby.
curricula: IB (International Baccalaureate, via nearby Zurich schools)

legal_admin.summary: Newcomers must register at the Einwohnerkontrolle Winterthur within 14 days of arrival. EU/EFTA nationals register for permit B or L at the Migrationsamt des Kantons Zürich. Non-EU nationals need a cantonal permit. Authority: sem.admin.ch.
legal_admin.registration_step: Anmeldung at Einwohnerkontrolle within 14 days; residence permit from cantonal migration authority

tax_finance.summary: The AHV-Nummer (OASI number) serves as the Swiss tax and social insurance ID, assigned by the SVA Zürich (cantonal compensation office) or employer. Winterthur is in Zurich canton, which applies Zurich cantonal income and wealth taxes. Withholding tax applies for foreign residents without a C-permit.

transport.summary: Winterthur's public transport is operated by STADTBUS Winterthur and integrated into the ZVV (Zürcher Verkehrsverbund) network, including S-Bahn connections to Zurich. A monthly pass costs approximately CHF 79 per Numbeo data. EU/EFTA driving licences are exchangeable within 12 months at the Strassenverkehrsamt Zürich without a driving test. Mandatory Krankenversicherung must be arranged within 3 months of arrival; regulated by BAG/OFSP.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EFTA licences exchangeable within 12 months at Strassenverkehrsamt Zürich (mfz.zh.ch); non-EU licences generally require theory and/or practical test
transport.healthcare_registration: Mandatory basic health insurance (Krankenversicherung/KVG) must be arranged within 3 months of arrival; choose a licensed insurer at bag.admin.ch
